newsitem.title: RUSSIA: De Beers in talks on Russia's Lomonosov gem field.
newsitem.headline: De Beers in talks on Russia's Lomonosov gem field.

text.p: South Africa's De Beers is in talks with Russian diamond mining firm Severalmaz to tap the giant Lomonosov diamond field in the northern Arkhangelsk region, a De Beers representative said Thursday.
"We have been talking for quite a long time with Severalmaz on Lomonosov, and we continue to do so," said Nick Pleasance, deputy managing director of De Beers' Moscow representation.

Viktor Chernov, head of the natural resources and mineral base development department of the northern Arkhangelsk region, which has jurisdiction over Lomonosov, told Reuters that an international tender for the gem field would be held this year.
Lomonosov, a project that will cost several billion dollars, is estimated to have rough gem reserves with a market value of around $12 billion.
Arkhangelsk region's Severalmaz mining company holds the licence to develop Lomonosov, Russia's largest unmined diamond deposit, where at least half the stones may be of gem quality.
De Beers has yet to seal a final gem export agreement with Russia, a major world supplier of rough diamonds.
